items.title: Lesley and Chang'e, short trailer
items.desc: A 50 second cut for the return of Chang'e Tech Tensai and Lesley Deadeye Spectre on 18 June. It runs from the lab memory through the burning city and into the game.

chapters.l: Logo and the title card, 18 June
A red corridor and a lab memory
A flashback of the burning city
The game: a skirmish with sniper shots
A cinematic burst and a vow
End card for the return of the skins

items.title: We Believe!, teaser
items.desc: A short teaser for the first Aspirants trailer, with the voice actress and the composer of the theme song. It was posted a few days before the trailer.

chapters.l: Two girls lying in the grass
A twin-blade figure in a bright doorway

items.title: Rekindled Light, teaser

chapters.l: Letter one: a warm lab memory
Letter four: an explosion and a fire fight
Announcement of the Rekindled Light trailer
End card with the release date

items.title: Layla and Fanny, short animation

The armored transformation and the alarm
A night flight over the city

items.desc: The composer of We Believe! talks about the Aspirants, the story, the characters and the music, and about what was hard in writing the song. English subtitles are in the picture.

items.title: The 3D process

items.title: We Believe!, Yoshino Nanjo in the studio

items.desc: A walk through the Aspirants event: what you can get, the skins, the bonuses and how to earn them.

items.desc: The revamped Ruby and Angela in the game, with their new effects.

items.title: The Aspirants rerun
items.desc: A vertical animated short about the return of the Aspirants skins.

items.title: Arrival at Selrick
items.desc: A new student arrives at Selrick Academy and hears of its ace duo, Guinevere and Vexana. A strange badge and a signal from the rooftop catch the eye.

chapters.l: Dissolve to a dark star-shaped rift over a rooftop with a figure

link.label: Play the drama on Vexana's page

items.title: The Emblem
items.desc: Guinevere says the badge is an Emblem of Hope. She and Vexana made it together, as proof of their bond.

chapters.l: Courtyard, Guinevere holds a small beacon-like device
Warm sunset flashback of two girls with matching emblems: bond
Back to Guinevere in the courtyard

link.label: Play the drama on Vexana's page

items.title: The Rooftop Signal
items.desc: Angela, Ruby and Guinevere track an unstable energy signal. Ruby fears it is an Ender, and that it is a lure.

link.label: Play the drama on Vexana's page

items.title: Where They Met
items.desc: Guinevere remembers how she and Vexana became partners. Her emblem still glows, and she is sure Vexana is waiting.

chapters.l: Corridor where Guinevere recalls meeting a partner: Team-Up Day
Back in the corridor, Guinevere holds her emblem

link.label: Play the drama on Vexana's page

items.title: Alarm at the Singularity
items.desc: Students report a dangerous signal from the Singularity. The emblem flashes, and Guinevere decides to go alone.

chapters.l: Holographic attendance HUD shows Vexana absent

link.label: Play the drama on Vexana's page

items.title: The Partner Test
items.desc: Guinevere tests the newcomer as a temporary partner. Layla judges the aim, and Guinevere admits she fears losing another partner.

chapters.l: Sunset rooftop flashback of two girls with cups

link.label: Play the drama on Vexana's page

items.title: Rescue Briefing
items.desc: The Aspirants gather before a map of the Singularity. The Enders are mobilizing, and the team is ready to bring Vexana back.

chapters.l: Auditorium crowd watches the Singularity rift on a big screen
Team briefing with three girls on a striped blue backdrop

link.label: Play the drama on Vexana's page

items.title: The Argument
items.desc: Guinevere admits she and Vexana quarreled the day Vexana vanished. Vexana had seen a doomed future, and Guinevere now sees she only meant to protect her.

chapters.l: Guinevere alone in a bookshelf-lined study at night
Back in the study after crossfade

link.label: Play the drama on Vexana's page

items.title: Fall Back
items.desc: The newcomer calls a retreat. Guinevere puts everything on the line and entrusts the academy to the newcomer.

chapters.l: Guinevere portrait on ruined city skyline, speaking her resolve

link.label: Play the drama on Vexana's page

items.title: Into the Battle
items.desc: Guinevere warns that this is real battle. An Ender strikes, and Vexana and Guinevere each try to shield the other.

link.label: Play the drama on Vexana's page

items.title: Witness Our Moment
items.desc: Vexana believes there is no other choice. Guinevere answers that the choice is theirs together, and the two strike as partners.

chapters.l: Academy audience watching a screen of the battle intercut with

link.label: Play the drama on Vexana's page

items.title: A New Future
items.desc: Guinevere will not let Vexana sacrifice herself. Their light destroys the Control Core, the Singularity disappears, and they stand together at sunset.

link.label: Play the drama on Vexana's page

items.title: United Light
items.desc: The whole squad stands behind Guinevere. They say that hope never dies and charge the Singularity together.

link.label: Play the drama on Vexana's page
